actor_information.routing: RlGamesVecEnvWrapper defaults policy -> obs, critic -> states. a2c_common.get_action_values runs actor on obs only, then replaces values with the separate central critic fed states. No direct privileged-state actor input found in these source paths.
actor_information.allowed_information: Noisy relative fingertip XYZ/quaternion, corrected finite-difference velocities, noisy wrist force, reward force threshold, previous applied actions; ideal robot proprioception in servo.

information_probe.scope: Specific actor and action-frame pathways; critic has privileged state. Ideal robot proprioception remains.

actor_information.limitations: Actor-only scripted replay and cached-target perturbation pass. An instantiated study PPO wrapper/network has not been exercised; the training actor-information gate stays false.

action_transforms.upstream_obs_clip: infinity from train.py default; observations normalized by PPO
action_transforms.target_frame: fixed_pos_obs_frame + init_fixed_pos_obs_noise, identical estimate in observations and action transforms
action_transforms.servo_clipping: Position/orientation error clipped against ideal measured robot pose; no hidden true fixture target found. Controller gains and dead zones are shared nuisance randomization.

reward.decision: Keep existing reward unchanged; the recovered case-1 variant returns more than its matched persistent insertion. No matched evidence justifies a shared correction.
reward.cohort_dependency: Success prediction penalty becomes active when current cohort success fraction >= 0.25 and stays latched on; it is initialized at environment construction, not cleared by Forge _reset_buffers. Batch/cohort composition and terminal holds can influence activation. Record this before selecting a training batching/terminal convention.

upstream_training_terminal_behavior.factory_get_dones: Returns the same full-cohort horizon mask as both terminated and truncated. It does not implement project success dwell, force abort or grasp-loss terminals.
upstream_training_terminal_behavior.direct_env_step_order: 8 physics steps -> dones -> reward -> reset ended cohort -> interval events -> next observations
upstream_training_terminal_behavior.learner_bootstrap: a2c_common.py lines 777-778 and 852-853 add gamma * pre-step values * time_outs to shaped rewards, including recurrent rollouts.

current_project_evaluator_behavior.automatic_done: PegStudyEnv returns false done masks and holds completed jobs until external finalization. Feeding it directly to PPO would omit finite-job terminal signals and continue upstream rewards.
current_project_evaluator_behavior.reward_cutoff: Offline ledger includes control endpoints at/before evaluator terminal step, discards the partial terminal interval and all later endpoints; absorbing zero, no bootstrap.

required_before_learning: Implement a finite-job training adapter with real done signals, recurrent-state handling and full-cohort initialization only between jobs. Include all absorbing holds/initialization/probe/mining costs in declared transition accounting.

Choose and verify terminal partial-control-step reward accounting consistently for training and evaluation; preserve these existing endpoint-only records and rerun matched returns if the convention changes.

Disable value bootstrap at the finite job deadline and all failure/success terminal states. Verify GAE/return behavior against synthetic terminal transitions and a bounded actual simulator wrapper run.
Exercise the instantiated PPO actor/critic routing and action transforms with privileged-state perturbation controls.

Keep fixed reward formula/scales, architecture, tuning budget, 25% nominal share and checkpoint selection by declared transitions; record cohort-latch semantics and freeze the protocol before long training.
scope_and_limitations: Local pinned source audit plus resolved configuration and scripted information probes; not a trained policy or verified study-training implementation.
No simulator or training launch was needed for this audit; existing run evidence is referenced by hash.
Finite-job integration remains an explicit blocking gate for long training.
